package.description: Runs Matterway skills in your browser from the employee machine as a local, human-in-the-loop assistant.

en-US.description: Runs Matterway skills in your browser from the employee machine as a local, human-in-the-loop assistant.
en-US.longDescription: Matterway Assistant is the local component of Matterway, the AI-native operations platform acquired by Cognizant (Nasdaq: CTSH) in October 2025. The Assistant runs on the local machine of the employee and enables the execution of skills in the browser, so user expertise and automation work together on the same task. Skills are authored, deployed and monitored in the Matterway Console, the hosted web application, and the Assistant carries them out locally using the same rights as the logged-in user. A Chrome or Edge extension is offered as an alternative execution route. Optionally, anonymized telemetry can be enabled to track usage patterns at the group level.
en-US.name: Matterway Assistant

zh-CN.description: 在员工本机以本地人在环助手的方式，在你的浏览器中执行 Matterway 技能。
zh-CN.longDescription: Matterway Assistant 是 Matterway（AI 原生运营平台，2025 年 10 月被 Cognizant（Nasdaq: CTSH）收购）的本地组件。Assistant 运行在员工自己的电脑上，让技能可以直接在浏览器中执行，使用户经验与自动化在同一个任务上协同工作。技能在托管的 Web 应用 Matterway Console 中编写、部署与监控，由 Assistant 以当前登录用户的权限在本机执行；另提供 Chrome / Edge 浏览器扩展作为替代的执行路径。必要时可开启匿名化遥测，在团队维度统计使用情况。
